title: Russian Fricatives

manual_evidence: All recordings were forced aligned with MAUS, but boundaries of all target fricatives were manually inspected and corrected in Praat; only target-fricative boundaries qualify for manual core

notes: Accept only the isolatable target-fricative manual-corrected layer. Do not admit general MAUS word/phone tiers as manual.
